products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company, formerly known as Watson Health, that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare sector. Its portfolio spans clinical decision support, enterprise imaging, clinical data management, cardiovascular workflow tools, and health data analytics, serving providers, payers, life sciences organizations, and government health programs.

The company's product lineup includes Micromedex, which delivers clinical decision support at the point of care; Zelta, a cloud-based platform for clinical data management and acquisition designed for clinical trials; and the Merge suite of enterprise imaging tools, comprising Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo described as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked. Truven provides health data analytics and consulting services, and the company also offers a portfolio focused on real-world evidence studies. Customer-reported outcomes cited on the site include a jump from a 17% to 80% auto-renewal rate for MAGI Medicaid, 36,000 hours in time savings, and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings within a single cohort.

The site's held facts categorize Merative under Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, with noted capabilities in healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance.
